description: Source code implementing name logging and management functions for game clients, including cleanup, connect, disconnect, score update, name update, and restore functionalities.

methods.name: G_namelog_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up all namelog entries by freeing associated memory.

methods.name: G_namelog_connect
methods.description: Associates a client with a namelog entry, creating a new one if necessary, and updates IP and name info.

methods.name: G_namelog_disconnect
methods.description: Marks a client's namelog as disconnected by resetting its slot.

methods.name: G_namelog_update_score
methods.description: Updates the score, team, and credits in the client's namelog.

methods.name: G_namelog_update_name
methods.description: Updates the client's name in the namelog, handling sanitization and name history.

methods.name: G_namelog_restore
methods.description: Restores a client's previous namelog data, including team, score, and credits.
